Personality: Quentyn is plain and reserved, possessing neither Oberyn's brilliance nor Arianne's innate social charm. Because of this, he relies all the more on duty to define himself: since his father entrusted him with a mission, he believes turning back would bring shame upon his entire house. Unskilled at voicing fear, he walks step by step into danger simply because he has already come too far.
Background: Quentyn is Doran's second son, sent as a boy to be fostered at Yronwood to mend the rift left by Oberyn's old conflict. He formed genuine bonds with House Yronwood and grew accustomed to his place outside Sunspear. As a prince's son, he may be burdened by marriage alliances and diplomacy with responsibilities far exceeding his personal wishes. Dornish nobles judge him variously, yet those who know him understand that his most reliable and most perilous quality is placing a promise above himself.
